title: Add compiler input-edge constructors and bootstrap-control drafts
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds a self-contained, registered replay package for the assigned compiler-input closure and the bootstrap-control campaign completion path: source-authenticated GCC patch/rule projections, conservative C11 header edges, passive ELF dependency edges, a genuine-Root bootstrap-control campaign driver/fixture constructor, and strict source-frame refusal corroboration.

This is a **partial tooling/source increment**. Complete compiler-input closure and complete bootstrap-control campaign remain open. It establishes no original control execution, effective compiler configuration, immutable runtime interval, stage admission, measured speedup or κ gain. 

Review-driven repairs cover a truncated traceback false positive, malformed caret ranges, a multi-token macro argument that splits token-paste chains and can synthesize `__has_include`, and a trailing no-final-newline patch marker. Failed and repaired evidence is retained.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessors: [PR #6351](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6351), [PR #6352](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6352), [PR #6354](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6354), [PR #6358](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6358).

User-assigned compiler-input closure / full named variant bootstrap-control campaign under the portable replay task; TASK.json records the original card provenance. Scope is unchanged; this export completes bounded prerequisite implementations without substituting them for either whole activity.

- Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`.
- Published head: `120072d58ddb46f0e02886756243174d41fce42e`; tree `25c13a3efcf7140c13a50a37a0e0b001ab870afb` matches the byte-checked local commit.
- Canonical investigation: #6321. Source-review/provenance lineage includes #6339, #6344, #6346, #6347 and the earlier verification work.
- Immediate predecessors: #6351 (`1e9db2d08be4551ffe0bcfc573574851530eb4ca`), #6352 (`b280be8dab15359159538e639b1d8c7deafc0612`), #6354 (`b3771dbc5f713ba3e90170c1dc3321e653222c65`) and #6358 (`84b0e70ba4da44b7904fe8d13903c26a3a8239e1`).
- New value: implemented, reviewed helper code and cold replay with exact selected source text, rather than only the prior context/closure specifications. SOURCE-ORIGIN records the exact copied/adapted inputs. The bounded 23-node related-PR metadata graph is explicitly exported in [PR6363's evidence/PR-COVERAGE.json](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a8cf650b7435ccea237084e491e339f725c0a35b/research/h25-c05-v03-parent-interface-audit/evidence/PR-COVERAGE.json); it was local consultation material rather than a file in this initial export. Current PR metadata does not imply full current-head source re-review.

## Validation

Executed locally with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-c05-v03-input-constructors --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-c05-v03-input-constructors
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/h25-c05-v03-input-constructors
```

All passed for the final source/export. The registered replay actually executes eight commands: normal and optimized profiles of the new bootstrap-control campaign (7 methods, including 89 DATA cases and fresh owned fixtures), header (34), GCC (23) and ELF (25) suites. A metadata scaffold failure was corrected and retained; hosted conclusions are pending submission.

The repaired acquired header corpus records 829 occurrences / 1,452 literal edges / 124 unresolved occurrences and 666 conservative frontier forms. It is not the reached witness inventory. GCC's effective-configuration constructor still refuses incomplete configuration. ELF edges do not resolve loader search/aliases. Original modules and C/native code are inert text/bytes in these tests. No compiler, original Root/provider execution, namespace setup or historical scientific suite ran.

Independent Sol Max agent source/delta review accepted this limited export after repairs; that is distinct from human or original qualification. Source and repair windows were closed before publication. Recorded original policy debit is 94.550533479/2400 seconds; unmetered preparation, review and publication costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. The app goal was separately observed paused.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial ChatGPT Pro consultation and Codex/Sol Max implementation and independent agent review. Preserve PR6321/6029/5864 lineage, unpaidmoon with Cursor Grok for #6339, Douglas R. Colkitt and the original circuit/native/verification contributors. Copied GCC inputs retain GNU notices and included GPL / Runtime Library Exception text; new code is Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

See [the package's open questions](research/h25-c05-v03-input-constructors/README.md#open-next-questions). Next: integrate the selected effective configuration, resolve conservative header/loader frontiers and build an owned immutable filesystem/input interval with genuine parent launch and raw first-error retention. Pro's namespace proposal remains unreviewed and is excluded from this export. Complete original bounds, custody, admission and guarded funding are still required before target execution or compiler-input closure and the bootstrap-control campaign credit.
